query: Please implement a website security system to defend against DDoS attacks. The system should have the functionality to detect and defend against DDoS attacks, including preventing flood attacks and malicious requests. The system should also be able to record and analyze attack logs, providing real-time security reports. Users should be able to configure security settings, customize defense strategies, and receive security alerts. Initialize the background color with linen and component color with saddle brown.
